# Matrix

> Matrix (mātṛkā) is an intelligence architecture studio in Kolkata, India. It designs the invisible architecture through which intelligence becomes trustworthy, scalable, and beneficial — original research, strategic counsel, and applied intelligence platforms for enterprises, governments, universities, and society. Products change over time; the capabilities and disciplines are permanent.

Matrix is capability-led, discipline-grounded, and cohered by design. Its work spans nine permanent capabilities grounded in two proprietary research frameworks, CES-QN and KALPA, and delivered through the Omega Model — a shared intelligence infrastructure on which every product is a node.

Key facts:
- Founded by Somnath Banerjee; based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India.
- Research is open access: six Zenodo preprints with permanent DOIs, plus a published patent application (QiDS, 202631019776 A).
- Products include Gravity (multi-agent decision intelligence), QiDS (human intelligence development), ARPS (supply chain intelligence), Humming (operational intelligence), Datum (analytics), Mangrove (sustainability), and PLUTO (frontier research).
- Contact: system@matrka.net · matrka.net · +91 9875 663 417

## Capabilities

- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.matrka.net/capabilities/ai): Copilots, agents, evaluation systems, and research into causal and self-evolving intelligence.
- [Systems](https://www.matrka.net/capabilities/systems): Enterprise architecture, supply-chain intelligence, digital twins, and decision systems on the CES-QN framework.
- [Engineering](https://www.matrka.net/capabilities/engineering): Platform engineering, SaaS infrastructure, API architecture, container-based hybrid compute.
- [Consulting](https://www.matrka.net/capabilities/consulting): AI readiness assessment, enterprise transformation, responsible AI governance, technology strategy.
- [Futurology](https://www.matrka.net/capabilities/futurology): Long-horizon research — NEO post-smartphone intelligence, ambient cognition, civilisation-scale decision systems.
- [Sustainability](https://www.matrka.net/capabilities/sustainability): ESG measurement, carbon and water intelligence, climate risk, compliance via the Mangrove programme.
- [Education & Social Innovation](https://www.matrka.net/capabilities/education): KALPA framework, curriculum intelligence, educational equity, NGO capability building.
- [Quanta](https://www.matrka.net/capabilities/quanta): Quantum-inspired computation (Quantassical), quantum magnetometry, photonic secure communications, NP-hard optimisation.
- [Design](https://www.matrka.net/capabilities/design): Applied intelligence design — human-centred interaction, information architecture, the design constitution.
